title: Assembly Whip Count — No Confidence
description: Vyktor has been working the Assembly floor all morning. He has the projected whip count for Kolvar's motion of no confidence — and a list of MPs whose votes can be swayed with the right resources.

title: The Vote
description: Drazen Kolvar has introduced a motion of no confidence. The parliament is divided. Every MP is watching. Your speech — whatever you say when the Speaker recognizes you — will determine whether your government survives its first existential test.

title: Budget Allocation — Post-Vote Framework
description: Whatever happens in the vote, the budget must continue. Prepare the fiscal framework for the next quarter before the political uncertainty freezes the treasury.

title: The Journalist's Investigation
description: Nadia Voss's story is in final draft. She called to say she'd found something else — something she wasn't looking for. She thinks you should know before it prints.

title: Kravenstal — Conditions Report
description: The Kravenstal steel collective is voting on a general strike. Foundry Square has been occupied for three days. The police commissioner wants instructions.

title: Cabinet Session — Government Continuity
description: The cabinet needs to hear from you before the vote. Some of them are already getting calls from Kolvar's people about retaining their posts 'in the next government.'
